configurePresets.name: minimal
configurePresets.description: Builds only the core runtime with no extensions or examples. Fastest build for development iteration.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Development build with commonly used extensions and examples enabled. Suitable for daily development.

configurePresets.name: full
configurePresets.description: Builds everything that can be built without special system dependencies (excludes zenoh, opentelemetry). Includes the iceoryx shared-memory transport, which extends configure/build time noticeably, and the self-developed shm transport alongside it (driver name shm, so the two do not clash).

configurePresets.name: iceoryx
configurePresets.displayName: Iceoryx — dev build focused on the iceoryx transport
configurePresets.description: Development build with examples and only the iceoryx shared-memory transport extension enabled. Useful for iterating on iceoryx demos and tests without paying the full-preset compile cost.

configurePresets.name: shm
configurePresets.displayName: Shm — dev build with the self-developed shared-memory transport
configurePresets.description: Development build with examples and the self-developed zero-copy shm transport (no RouDi, no iceoryx). Linux/OHOS only.

configurePresets.name: together-ros2-minimal-sdk
configurePresets.description: Compatibility-focused build using an explicit Humble Fast DDS 2.6.12/Fast CDR 1.0.29 prefix, without ROS2 runtime or examples.

configurePresets.name: ros2
configurePresets.displayName: ROS 2 (DEPRECATED) — full build with ROS 2 rcl integration
configurePresets.description: DEPRECATED: Full build with ROS 2 rcl support. Use 'full' preset instead — IBMW now provides pure-DDS alternatives for all ROS2 interop (pub/sub and RPC/Service). Requires ROS 2 (Humble or Jazzy) to be sourced.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized release build of the core runtime and all extensions, without examples or tests.

configurePresets.name: test
configurePresets.displayName: Test — dev build with tests enabled
configurePresets.description: Development build with tests enabled for CI/CD pipelines.

configurePresets.name: cross-aarch64-minimal
configurePresets.description: Configures a minimal AArch64 cross build with direct ROS2 feature tiers disabled by default.

configurePresets.name: cross-aarch64-dds-source-deps
configurePresets.displayName: Cross AArch64 — DDS with source-built target deps
configurePresets.description: Configures an AArch64 DDS build lane with ExternalProject source-prefix targets for TinyXML2, foonathan_memory, FastCDR, and FastDDS. Build target ibmw_third_party_source_prefix first, then reconfigure/build against that prefix.

configurePresets.name: cross-aarch64-dds-source
configurePresets.displayName: Cross AArch64 — DDS source-prefix second pass

configurePresets.name: cross-ohos-arm64-minimal
configurePresets.displayName: Cross OHOS ARM64 — minimal runtime scaffolding
configurePresets.description: Configures a minimal OHOS arm64-v8a cross build with ROS2-related feature tiers disabled by default.

configurePresets.name: cross-ohos-arm64-dds-source-deps
configurePresets.displayName: Cross OHOS ARM64 — DDS with source-built target deps
configurePresets.description: Configures an OHOS ARM64 DDS build lane with ExternalProject source-prefix targets for TinyXML2, foonathan_memory, FastCDR, and FastDDS. Build target ibmw_third_party_source_prefix first, then reconfigure/build against that prefix.

configurePresets.name: cross-ohos-arm64-dds-source
configurePresets.displayName: Cross OHOS ARM64 — DDS source-prefix second pass
